citations.assessment: The dossier gives the brothers and reports from Shmuel involving Avuha. Megillah names both sons, and Bava Metzia and Nazir name Avuha with Shmuel.
The Bavli contrasts the two brothers and states Elijah spoke with one and did not speak with the other. Heilprin summarizes in the plural.
The dedicated dossier retains the Rava bar Ittai variant. The bare listing does not prove a family relationship.
